reactions.description: The last step in the biosynthesis of nigericin is the hydroxylation of the 30th carbon by NigD

An inhibitor of cytochrome P450 mono-oxygenases led to the accumulation of grisorixin (C-30-dehydroxylnigericin) and overexpression of nigD variant (mimicking demalonylation) increases nigericin production.

evidenceCode: Inference from genomic data and chemical structure
